zh.title: 巴西航空工業 Phenom 300EV 獲三重認證 首款配備 Garmin Autoland
zh.summary: Phenom 300EV 獲三重認證；首款內建 Garmin Autoland；2028 年交付
body: 巴西航空工業於 2026 年 8 月 25 日宣布，Phenom 300EV 獲得巴西民航局（ANAC）、美國聯邦航空總署（FAA）及歐盟航空安全局（EASA）三重認證。這款於 2025 年 7 月發布的輕型噴射機可載四名乘客，是 Phenom 300 系列的最新演進機型。
新機型相較於 2020 年認證的 Phenom 300E，載荷能力提升，航程從 2,010 海浬（3,722 公里）延長至 2,055 海浬（3,806 公里）。最大亮點是標配 Garmin Autoland 系統，成為輕型噴射機類別首款、也是迄今最大型搭載此新一代安全系統的噴射機。
Garmin Autoland 為緊急自動著陸系統，當飛行員失去駕駛能力時，可自動選擇最近合適機場、規劃航路、執行進場並著陸，全程無需人為干預。系統可由駕駛員或乘客手動啟動，亦可在偵測到飛行員可能無法操作時自動啟動。
通訊方面，Phenom 300EV 出廠即裝設 Gogo Galileo 低軌衛星連網，Starlink 則為選配，透過補充型別認證（STC）事後加裝。機上另配備多功能電子控制器（MEC），實現自動煞車與線控方向舵，並整合 Garmin 3D 滑行路線引導、跑道佔用感知、合成視覺導引系統（SVGS）、FANS 1/A 及 RNP AR 0.3 等航電功能。
巴西航空工業規劃於 2028 年開始向客戶交付 Phenom 300EV。此次三重認證為後續量產交付鋪平道路，也標誌著單駕駛營運環境下的安全技術邁出關鍵一步。

en.title: Embraer Phenom 300EV Secures Triple Certification, First Light Jet with Garmin Autoland
en.summary: Embraer Phenom 300EV receives triple certification; first light jet with Garmin Autoland; deliveries from 2028
body: On 25 August 2026, Embraer announced that the Phenom 300EV had received triple certification from Brazil’s National Civil Aviation Agency (ANAC), the United States Federal Aviation Administration (FAA), and the European Union Aviation Safety Agency (EASA). Unveiled in July 2025, the light jet carries four passengers and represents the latest evolution of the Phenom 300 family.

Compared with the Phenom 300E certified in 2020, the 300EV offers increased payload and a range extended from 2,010 nautical miles (3,722 km) to 2,055 nautical miles (3,806 km). Its most notable new feature is the inclusion of the Garmin Autoland system as standard equipment, making it the first light jet and the largest jet to date to be equipped with this next-generation safety system.

Garmin Autoland is an emergency autonomous landing system designed to take control if the pilot becomes incapacitated. It can select a suitable airport, navigate a route avoiding terrain and weather, execute the approach, land, apply brakes and bring the aircraft to a stop without human intervention. Activation can be manual via a dedicated button by the pilot or a passenger, or automatic when the system detects conditions indicating the pilot may no longer be able to fly.

Connectivity upgrades include factory-fitted Gogo Galileo low-Earth-orbit satellite connectivity, with Starlink available as an aftermarket installation via a Supplemental Type Certificate. The aircraft also features a Multi-Purpose Electronic Controller (MEC) enabling autobrake and rudder-by-wire, along with Garmin 3D Taxiway Routing, Runway Occupancy Awareness, Synthetic Vision Guidance System (SVGS), FANS 1/A and RNP AR 0.3 capabilities.

Embraer plans to begin customer deliveries of the Phenom 300EV in 2028. The triple certification clears the way for production and marks a significant step for safety technology in single-pilot operations.

facts.claim: Embraer announced on 25 August 2026 that the Phenom 300EV obtained triple certification from ANAC, FAA, and EASA.
facts.sourceQuote: On August 25, 2026, Brazilian aircraft manufacturer Embraer announced that the Phenom 300EV obtained triple certification, from the National Civil Aviation Agency of Brazil (ANAC), the United States (FAA), and the European Union (EASA).

facts.claim: The Phenom 300EV was launched in July 2025, carries four passengers, and is an evolution of the Phenom 300 family.
facts.sourceQuote: Launched in July 2025 and capable of carrying four passengers, the Phenom 300EV is an evolution of Embraer’s popular light jet family

facts.claim: The Phenom 300EV's range increased to 2,055 nautical miles (3,806 km) from 2,010 nautical miles (3,722 km) for the Phenom 300E.
facts.sourceQuote: slightly longer range (from 2,010 nautical miles to 2,055 nautical miles or 3,722 to 3,806 km)

facts.claim: The Phenom 300EV is the first light jet and largest jet to be equipped with Garmin Autoland as standard.
facts.sourceQuote: The Phenom 300EV will be the first aircraft in the light jet category and the largest jet aircraft so far to be equipped with this new generation safety system.

facts.claim: The Phenom 300EV will be line-fitted with Gogo Galileo LEO satellite connectivity, with Starlink as an optional addition.
facts.sourceQuote: The new Phenom 300EV will also be line-fitted with Gogo Galileo’s low Earth orbit (LEO) satellite connectivity, with Starlink as an optional addition.

facts.claim: First deliveries of the Phenom 300EV are planned for 2028.
facts.sourceQuote: The first deliveries of Phenom 300EV jets to customers are planned for 2028.
